SELECT /* LoginHistMapper.selectLoginHistList 로그인 이력 (최근 500건) */ DATE_FORMAT(H.LOGIN_DTM, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS LOGIN_DTM , H.MB_ID , L.LOGIN_ID , E.EMP_NM , H.LOGIN_IP FROM TBSY_LOGIN_HIST H LEFT OUTER JOIN TBSY_LOGIN L ON L.MB_ID = H.MB_ID AND L.EMP_CD = H.EMP_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TBIN_EMPMST E ON E.MB_ID = H.MB_ID AND E.EMP_CD = H.EMP_CD WHERE H.MB_ID = #{mbId}
AND H.LOGIN_DTM >= STR_TO_DATE(#{fromYmd}, '%Y%m%d')
AND H.LOGIN_DTM < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{toYmd}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND L.LOGIN_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{loginId}, '%')
ORDER BY H.LOGIN_DTM DESC LIMIT 500
